item.title: Encryption at Rest
item.description: When dealing with Kubernetes secrets, the values are not only stored in the definitions used to create the resources. Critically, they are also stored in the etcd store that the cluster uses for configuration. By default, secret values in this store can just be read directly which is a vulnerability.
